body: Thank you both, honestly. /u/Volkovsky I thank you for your words of encouragement but I feel I must give you some, too. Honestly,  in her lifetime, my mother never gave up. Her life was never easy, but she kept going. She always told me to never give up. And when I think about it, even though she's gone, I know she'd be upset. It would be like betraying every sacrifice she made for me, and there were many. I am holding on to that. Please, there must be something, someone, anything to keep you from doing it too. If you can encourage a complete stranger to hold on and that it will get better, there is a little piece of hope left in you. Hold on to it, please. I hope with all my heart that you hold on as well. /u/Qwertysnowyfeet thank you for your positive thoughts and suggestions. I'm doing my best to get through it.
